name: Scoriaceous-Nave
description: A battered sphere of bare stone, cratered so densely that old impacts overlap like raindrops on a pond. Through it all runs towering mountain ranges, stark under a black sky.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Around the spatial rift remnant, reality bends in small ways. Compasses sulk, clocks gain seconds, and long-stay crews develop identical tics.
Research vessels hold position at a respectful distance and take turns being unnerved. The anomaly, for its part, seems patient.
